Worn smooth. Eamon flipped it before every hard thing and said: heads or tails, it always lands on keep going. You have stopped checking which side lands.

◈ "UNIT TRAIL COMPASS — [TRANSLATION COMPLETE] — we have been watching you carry this. Attachment waveform: significant. Function decoded: +resolve when worn; harder to get truly lost. You knew it mattered before we did. Cute."

◈ FLASHBACK — Trail compass
Lost above the fog line, visibility down to your boots. You didn't panic — just held the compass flat, found north, and walked out like it was nothing. It was not nothing.

◈ FLASHBACK — Tasting Spoon
Your first Saturday service, you were sixteen and the chef handed you this spoon without a word. Tap twice, taste, know. You still tap twice — the tickets are gone but the habit isn't.

◈ "UNIT FIELD SUTURE KIT — [TRANSLATION COMPLETE] — we have been watching you carry this. Attachment waveform: significant. Function decoded: +resolve when worn; usable: +15 health. You knew it mattered before we did. Cute."

You practiced on an orange. 'People are just oranges that bleed,' your instructor said, and then taught you how to not flinch. You haven't flinched since.
